blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Беседа зашла за ___ (полночь).
exercises.prompt: The conversation lasted until after midnight.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Тони начал встречаться с Анджелой пять ___ (месяцы) назад.
exercises.prompt: Tony started dating Angela five months ago.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This stream runs dry every summer.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You have to pay 10,000 yen extra on holidays.
exercises.ru: В ___ нужно доплачивать десять тысяч иен.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This year, Valentine's Day falls on a Thursday.
exercises.ru: В этом году Валентинов день приходится на ___.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Евгений Замятин, «Островитяне»*
exercises.ru: Через ___, приглядевшись, Кембл увидел О’Келли — не улыбался.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. From Евгений Замятин, «Островитяне».

exercises.q: Can you pay off your loans in a year?
exercises.ru: Вы можете погасить задолженность по кредитам за ___?
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Latin Americans know very little about the history of the indigenous peoples who used to live here several centuries ago.
exercises.ru: Латиноамериканцы очень мало знают об истории коренных народов, которые жили здесь несколько ___ назад.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Госпожа Кляйн проводит контрольную ___ (каждая пятница).
exercises.prompt: Miss Klein gives a test every Friday.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Шаббат начинается в ___ (пятница) вечером.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я подарил Тому на ___ (день) рождения бейсболку.
exercises.prompt: I gave Tom a baseball cap for his birthday.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: А затем мгновение — прыжок через ___ (века), с + на −.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. From Евгений Замятин, «Мы».

exercises.q: Сталь закаляется за ___ (одна секунда).
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Люди жили точно несколько ___ (столетия) назад.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. From Владимир Короленко, «История моего современника».

exercises.q: Many Welsh books are published every year.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This custom is dying out nowadays.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Don't leave your Christmas lights on overnight.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Алексей Н. Толстой, «Аэлита»*
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. From Алексей Н. Толстой, «Аэлита».

exercises.q: In Moscow, precipitation equivalent to a quarter of the monthly norm fell over the course of a day.
exercises.ru: В Москве за ___ выпала четверть месячной нормы осадков.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Викентий Вересаев, «На войне»*
exercises.ru: Пассажир, несколько ___ назад проезжавший через Иркутск, видел самый погром.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. From Викентий Вересаев, «На войне».
